from src.lru import LRUCache


def test_put_get():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put("a", 1)
    assert c.get("a") == 1


def test_missing_returns_none():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    assert c.get("zzz") is None

    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put("a", 1)
    c.put("b", 2)
    c.put("c", 3)
    assert c.get("a") is None
    assert c.get("c") == 3

    c.put("b", 2)
    c.get("a")
